name: Kimpton Hotel Palomar Philadelphia
insider_take: Nestled in the heart of Philadelphia's vibrant Rittenhouse Square neighborhood, the Kimpton Hotel Palomar Philadelphia is a chic, art-forward boutique hotel that blends the city's rich history with bold, contemporary style — all with Kimpton's signature warmth.
whats_special: Housed in a striking 1929 neoclassical-style building, the Palomar artfully balances historic Philadelphia architecture with modern, eclectic interiors. As part of IHG's Destinia Program, guests earn IHG One Rewards points while enjoying Kimpton's boutique-hotel soul — the best of both worlds. The hotel's on-site restaurant, Square 1682 , celebrates locally sourced Pennsylvania ingredients with creative, farm-to-table cuisine. Kimpton's beloved Social Hour offers complimentary wine each evening — a fan-favorite perk that makes the Palomar feel instantly like home.
pro_tip: Request a room on an upper floor facing Rittenhouse Square for sweeping views of one of America's most beloved urban green spaces — especially stunning in fall foliage season.
dont_miss: Rittenhouse Square Park — steps from the hotel, this iconic park is perfect for a morning stroll or people-watching. The Philadelphia Museum of Art is just minutes away — run the famous Rocky Steps for a true Philly rite of passage. Explore the city's legendary Reading Terminal Market , a short ride away, for incredible local food and a true taste of Philadelphia culture.
pros: Chic Art-Deco Design in the Heart of Center City — Stylish rooms with bold, curated décor and a vibrant boutique atmosphere steps from Rittenhouse Square.
Signature Kimpton Perks Included — Enjoy complimentary morning coffee and tea, a hosted evening wine hour, and IHG One Rewards benefits through the Destined Program.
Exceptionally Pet-Friendly — One of Philadelphia's most welcoming hotels for travelers with pets, with no size or weight restrictions and complimentary pet amenities.
Rooftop Bar & On-Site Dining — The lively Square 1682 restaurant and rooftop terrace offer craft cocktails and locally inspired cuisine with city views.
Prime Location for Culture & Business — Walking distance to top Philadelphia museums, theaters, restaurants, and the Pennsylvania Convention Center.
cons: Urban Setting — As a Center City hotel, street noise and limited on-site green space may not suit travelers seeking a quieter, resort-style retreat.
Valet-Only Parking — Self-parking is not available; guests must use the hotel's valet service, which adds an additional daily cost.
